newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian blue-chip index breaks above 2,000.
newsitem.headline: Belgian blue-chip index breaks above 2,000.

text.p: Belgium's Bel-20 blue-chip index reached a record high on Wednesday, breaking above the 2,000 point level in early trade.
By 0911 GMT the share index stood up 2,005.16, up 0.69 percent, after opening at 2,002.35.
Dealers said the bullish trend was due to continued gains on Wall Street, market optimism on interest rates and corporate earnings and a strong dollar.
